name: atomic-fm
description: If-then help menu for Atomic.FM — click a button, get the next step.

root.title: Atomic.FM
root.content: Need help with the in-game radio plugin? Pick a path. Each button is an **if you want this, then…** step.

buttons.label: I just need the stream URL

listen.title: Listen in Space Engineers
listen.content:
If you want the station in-game, then:
1. Install **Atomic.FM** in Pulsar and enable it.
2. Open a block that has **Custom Data** (not plain armor).
3. Paste the config, then stand near the block.

What kind of block are you using?

sound_block.title: Sound Block
sound_block.content:
If you picked a Sound Block, then paste this into Custom Data:
```
atomic.fm=true
atomic.fm.range=35
atomic.fm.volume=1.5
```
Range is meters. Volume is `0.0`–`11.0`. Toggle playback with **Ctrl+Alt+M**.

other_block.title: Any Custom Data block
other_block.content:
If the block has Custom Data, then the same keys work — Sound Block is not required.
```
atomic.fm=true
atomic.fm.range=35
atomic.fm.volume=1.5
```
If you hear nothing, the block has no Custom Data (armor) or you are outside `atomic.fm.range`.

stream.title: Stream URL
stream.content:
If you only need the audio, then use:
`http://radio.atomic.fm:8000/atomic-radio`

broken.title: It's not playing
broken.content: If the radio is silent, then pick the closest match.

buttons.label: I am far from the block
I hear it, but it's quiet

range.title: Range
range.content: If you walked away, then you left `atomic.fm.range` (default 35 m). Raise it in Custom Data, e.g. `atomic.fm.range=80`.

volume.title: Volume
volume.content: If it is too quiet, then raise `atomic.fm.volume` (up to `11.0`) and check the in-game HUD volume. **Ctrl+Alt+M** toggles playback.

dj.title: DJ tools
dj.content: If you have the DJ or Admin role, then you see this node. Put Icecast / playlist notes here.
